name: Sabasa King
source:
The Ninth King of Sabasa, also known as the Emperor of the Burning Sands, is the current ruler of the Sabasa Kingdom. He is a descendant of Sphinx, the first Queen of Sabasa, and therefore has monster blood within him, something he takes great pride in. Additionally, he is capable of sensing the power behind other beings, able to identify monsters in disguise. Despite his fearsome appearance he puts his subjects and his duties as king first. 

[From [url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/Sabasa_King]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
